mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized), a federal funds rate increase above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening that elevates equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll employment exceeding 140,000 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 100 (2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), declining payroll employment below 140,000 thousand persons signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 140000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly housing starts exceeding 1,200 thousand units indicate strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
